summary: Six of six seats succeeded at high effort. Gemini approved; Claude, Codex, Qwen, Kimi and GLM asked for revision. Six concerns reached two supporters: IR1's composed load is worded for every model and ignores --reference-root, IR3 has no include-refusal mapping, IR2-C5's extract message is unscoped, the evaluate_judgments guard wording contradicts IR1-C6, homes omit docs, and H11's path. Qwen raised 14 of the 24 concerns.

agreed_concerns.title: IR1's composed load is worded for every model and ignores --reference-root
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 2 IR1 loads every model with load_model_bytes_composed, which binds references at the model directory: an include-free model changes output (R0.6, IR1-C7, model_digest) and an include root with a separate --reference-root cannot bind its references.

agreed_concerns.title: H11 cites the example without its src/gnd prefix
agreed_concerns.summary: The assertion-admission example lives at src/gnd/examples/literature/assertion_admission.py, not examples/literature/.

agreed_concerns.title: IR2-C5 changes the extract message for every temporal model, against R0.6 and section 2
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 2 scopes the new extract message to temporal include roots; IR2-C5 is unconditional, so an include-free temporal model would change output, which R0.6 forbids.

agreed_concerns.title: Section 2 says evaluate_judgments drops its guard while IR1-C6 keeps it
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 2 IR1 says the include guard in evaluate_judgments is dropped; IR1-C6 keeps test_R4_judgments as a pin of that guard for callers without model_root.

agreed_concerns.title: Section 3 homes omit docs section 5 assigns
agreed_concerns.summary: Release notes and the route-list rows each phase adds are missing from the section 3 homes.

agreed_concerns.title: IR3 has no mapping or criterion for include refusals in the exporters
agreed_concerns.summary: Once the export include guard is replaced by the composed loader, a ModelValidationError from composition falls to EXIT_INTERNAL in commands/export.py; no IR3 criterion pins exit 3 with the include code.

prioritized_fixes.title: Map composition refusals to exit 3 in both exporters
prioritized_fixes.action: Require render_pyrel and pyrel_rules.render to translate composed-loader and flattening refusals into ExportInputError, and add an IR3 criterion: a stale pin and a nested include exit 3 with the include code in both modes.

prioritized_fixes.title: Register gnd flatten in src/gnd/cli.py
prioritized_fixes.action: Add src/gnd/cli.py to IR2's homes with its parser registration and dispatch.

prioritized_fixes.title: Compose only include roots; keep reference binding at --reference-root
prioritized_fixes.action: Say in section 2 that only a root declaring includes takes the composed route, compose without binding references, then bind them with bind_declared_references at reference_root or the model directory; add a criterion with a separate --reference-root.

prioritized_fixes.title: Scope the extract message to include roots
prioritized_fixes.action: Narrow IR2-C5 to a temporal include root and add a control that an include-free temporal model keeps today's message (rf1 goldens).

prioritized_fixes.title: Say which digest each check compares
prioritized_fixes.action: State that the stale-subject check compares the root file's sha256 and that the report's model_digest is the composed identity; the two differ by design.

prioritized_fixes.title: Decide the existing-output exit
prioritized_fixes.action: Fix in the plan that gnd flatten refuses an existing output file with exit 11 and writes nothing.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make IR3-C3 a single expected outcome
prioritized_fixes.action: Fix the expected outcome at IR3's spec gate from RP2's merge state, recorded with the commit read.

prioritized_fixes.title: Reword the evaluate_judgments guard
prioritized_fixes.action: Section 2: the guard stays for callers without model_root and is skipped when model_root is named.

prioritized_fixes.title: Add docs to the homes
prioritized_fixes.action: Add docs/release-notes.md and the route-list row to each phase's homes.

prioritized_fixes.title: Correct the two citations
prioritized_fixes.action: H11 path under src/gnd/examples; H6 line range api.py:1195-1198.

prioritized_fixes.title: Say where each criterion's inputs come from
prioritized_fixes.action: State that tests author policies and receipts, flatten in process with flatten_model (LX1, shipped), and that IR2-C2 is gnd check parity over checking.orm.json, separate from R0.4.

prioritized_fixes.title: Name the guard and extract tests in the lanes
prioritized_fixes.action: Name the extract golden tests in IR2's lane and point each lane at the guard block explicitly.

prioritized_fixes.title: Cite the mandatory pin
prioritized_fixes.action: Cite model/_includes.py:61-77, which refuses an include without a 64-hex sha256.
